evidence.quote: SKOV has been operating in the market since 1966 and has become one of the world's leading ventilation and farm management systems suppliers, with over 500 employees. || Besides its headquarters in Denmark, the SKOV Group has subsidiary companies in Thailand, China, and the United States.
